versions.changelog:
- Improved clarity of installation instructions by removing the mandatory one-click child skill install step.
- Now lists ClawHub and GitHub links for each child skill, allowing selective installation.
- Updated environment variable requirements in metadata for clearer user setup.
- Polished and streamlined documentation; removed AI agent-only instructions.
- Minor corrections to trading hours and formatting for enhanced accuracy and readability.

Initial release of wudao-ashare: a comprehensive A-share market data toolkit.

- Provides 26 real-time API interfaces covering K-line, market sentiment, funds flow, block rotation, research report rankings, and more.
- Installs 4 sub-skill packages automatically: wudao-market, wudao-limitup, wudao-analysis, wudao-intel.
- One API Key is used for all interfaces and sub-skills.
- Detailed setup instructions and agent operation requirements included.
